title: 第7章 圣旨
content_zh:
第7章圣旨
南京城这几日下了一场雨，江南的雨总像是前列腺炎一般，总是欲下又止，下而不尽，又如半遮面的妇人一般，总是少了畅快。
天气骤冷了一些，东宫那边，有宦官给张世安送来了一件新衣，是太子和太子妃怕张安世不知冷热，特地命人送来的。
虽然张安世不缺衣衫，不过却也知道，每逢变天，东宫总会赐下衣物，其实是提醒张安世加一件衣衫的意思。
张安世又兴冲冲地去了学堂。
只是今日，学堂里却起了变化。
胡俨宅邸的院墙外，却见一个个穿着飞鱼衣的禁卫跨刀林立，三步一岗，五步一哨。
俨然一副如临大敌的样子。
院墙里头，竟还传出了惨呼。
张安世下了马车，两腿一紧。
骇然瞥向随来的张三：“呀……我恩师胡俨公被抄家了吗？”
张三眨眨眼，吞咽了口水，吓得不敢说话。
张安世孤身进了学堂，才发现在这前院里，十几个少年跪了一地。
朱勇更惨，耷拉着脑袋，居然还有人给他上了枷，这笨重的木枷套在他的脖子上，他一瞅见张安世，口里道：“大哥，快跑。”
张安世打了个激灵，却又听到了惨叫。
这一声惨叫渐渐清晰了，却见有人被按在木凳上，用皮鞭抽打。
张安世定睛一看，不是张軏是谁？
张軏一面嗷嗷叫，似乎也瞥见了张安世，便大吼道：“大哥，大哥，你赶紧跑，他们要来打你了。”
行刑的穿着飞鱼服，一旁还站着一个冷面的宦官。
张安世此时吓得两腿都有些哆嗦了。

他是两世为人不假，可第一次见这样肃杀的场面，实在是经验不足。
下意识的，张安世就想跑，可随即又想：这个时候跑会不会晚了？
就怕跑了，后果更惨。
深吸一口气，定了定神后，张安世很乖巧地道：“我不跑，我认罚，我也罚跪去。”
说着一溜烟，就要往那跪了一地的少年中腾挪出一个位置。
可那宦官却是抬头看了张安世一眼：“你是哪个？”
张安世道：“张安世。”
宦官随即拿出了一个簿子，翻了翻，却道：“张安世？噢，你的奏疏颇好，可见是用功了的，不必受罚。”
张安世一下子轻松了。
此时此刻，又一道鞭子狠狠挥舞下去。
张軏杀猪一般的嚎叫。
口里还含糊不清的说着：“大哥，你不是说胡写的吗？”
张安世几乎要留下同情的眼泪。
那宦官又道：“张公子既然不必受罚，今日这学堂也无课业，还是请回吧。”
张軏也唧唧哼哼道：“大哥，你留在此心里不忍，还是走吧，我挺得住。”
“噢。”张安世点点头，一溜烟的跑了。
张軏：“……”
不过张軏来不及思考，很快又发出了杀猪一般的惨叫声。
张三在看顾着马车，正在外头探头探脑，旋即便见张安世如兔子一般从府邸里窜出来。
张三长松一口气，惊喜地上前：“少爷……咋啦，胡师傅真被抄家啦？”

“事情比想象中严重，我几个兄弟怕是折在里头了。”
“可是少爷您……”
“我学业有成，自然不会受罚。”
张三耷拉着脑袋，似乎脑袋在高速的运转，推敲着这话里是不是有其他的歧义。
张安世道：“赶紧走为上策，不要在此啰嗦，我兄弟打成这个样子，我心疼得厉害，得给他们去抓药。”
“噢。”张三愣愣地点点头。
“奉天承运皇帝，制曰：近日听闻东宫太子亲眷胡作非为，皇亲国戚不得约束，猖狂如这般，实不像样。俺每思之，这定是东宫骄纵的缘故，太子不能管教亲眷，又怎生治理天下，今日俺下旨告诫于你，教你这太子知晓好歹，切不能再姑息罔纵，如有下次，绝不轻饶，钦哉！”
此时，在东宫里，一个宦官正扯着嗓子，唱诺着一份来自于宫中的旨意。
旨意中的话很粗俗，当然，其实这也一向是朱棣圣旨的风格。
太子朱高炽规矩地跪在地上，听完了圣旨，却已是诚惶诚恐，面无人色。
念旨的宦官宣读毕了，便小心翼翼地陪笑：“殿下……”
朱高炽叹了口气：“知晓了，你且去复旨。”
宦官去了。
朱高炽只是唏嘘，回了东宫内苑。
此时，太子妃张氏来迎太子。
朱高炽握着她的手，郁郁不乐。
张氏忧心仲仲地道：“安世又惹祸了？”
朱高炽点点头，叹道：“这一次不同，现在是上达天听了，父皇亲自下旨责骂……哎……”
张氏一听，顿时意识到问题的严重，忙道：“陛下下了旨意，难免在百官看来，这是陛下厌恶殿下的信号，若是有心人借此落井下石，搜罗殿下其他的过失，只怕墙倒众人推……”
一般情况之下，皇帝是不会责骂太子的，毕竟太子是储君，需要树立一定的威信，那么申饬也会十分婉转，可这一次如此不客气，只怕陛下要动什么念头了。

朱高炽沉默了片刻，道：“本宫这里不担心，倒是安世……那些居心叵测的人未必敢动本宫，却可借着安世来做文章，对安世不利。”
张氏便如这南京城里难测的天气一般，转瞬之间便眼里含泪，泪水如珠链一般的啪嗒落下来，哽咽道：“可怜我这兄弟，早年便没了爹，我这做姐姐的，嫁入了宫门，宫门森严，也没法成日看顾管教。只剩他孑身一人在外头，年轻又不能晓事，身边只怕不少狐朋狗友诱骗他为非作歹……”
朱高炽为之动容，忙安慰道：“安世本心是好的，你且不哭，一切可以从长计议。”
张氏眼泪立即收住了，看着一旁的小宦官道：“去将我那兄弟叫来。”
于是宦官匆匆去了。
张安世这一次是真的受了刺激，尤其是看到张軏的屁股被打得皮开肉绽之后，更有一种兔死狐悲的感觉。
他被人召到了东宫，进入内苑。
匆匆入殿，就看到了自己的姐姐张氏，于是笑嘻嘻地道：“阿姐。”
张氏摆出不喜的样子：“你又做了什么事，我真可怜，娘家没有依靠也罢，你这做兄弟的不能分忧，却还成日惹事生非。”
朱高炽在旁道：“好了，好了……”
张氏道：“你瞧瞧他嬉皮笑脸的样子……哎……”说罢，便伸手擦拭眼泪啜泣起来。
张安世见不得这样，忙收了笑，耷拉着脑袋道：“我又做错什么啦？”
张氏道：“今日陛下下了圣旨，申饬你的姐夫，说他管教无方，还说纵容包庇，他是太子啊，堂堂太子，被这样的训斥，这满朝文武哪一个不在看笑话呢！”
“你这傻兄弟，难道还不晓得你姐夫有多为难吗？陛下不喜他，圣驾身边又不知有多少奸邪小人，每日挑拨是非，你看看你姐夫操心成了什么样子。”
张安世便去看朱高炽。
却见朱高炽也是愁眉苦脸的样子，却强打精神道：“我是人子，不能为君分忧，被训斥也是该当的……安世年纪还小，罢了……说这些有什么意思。”
content_en:
Chapter 7 Imperial Edict
It has been raining in Nanjing in the past few days. The rain in Jiangnan is always like prostatitis. It always starts to fall and then stops, but it never stops. It is also like a woman whose face is half-covered, always less refreshing.
The weather suddenly got colder. Over in the East Palace, a eunuch sent Zhang Shian a new dress. The prince and princess specially ordered it to be delivered because they were afraid that Zhang Anshi would not know the cold or heat.
Although Zhang Anshi is not short of clothes, he also knows that whenever the weather changes, the East Palace will always give clothes, which is actually to remind Zhang Anshi to add a piece of clothes.
Zhang Anshi went to school happily again.
But today, something changed in the school.
Outside the courtyard wall of Hu Yan's residence, guards wearing flying fish suits were seen standing in a forest with swords straddling each other, with one post every three steps and one sentry every five steps.
He looked like he was facing a formidable enemy.
Inside the courtyard wall, there were even screams of misery.
Zhang Anshi got off the carriage and tightened his legs.
He glanced at Zhang San who was following him in shock: "Ah...has the house of my mentor Hu Yangong been ransacked?"
Zhang San blinked and swallowed, too scared to speak.
Zhang Anshi entered the school alone and found that in the front yard, more than a dozen teenagers were kneeling on the ground.
Zhu Yong was even worse, with his head hanging down. Someone actually put a shackle on him. This heavy wooden shackle was put around his neck. When he saw Zhang Anshi, he said: "Brother, run quickly."
Zhang Anshi shuddered, but heard screams again.
The scream gradually became clearer, and someone was seen being pinned down on a wooden bench and beaten with a whip.
Zhang Anshi took a closer look, who was it not Zhang Fu?
Zhang Fu screamed and seemed to have caught a glimpse of Zhang Anshi, so he yelled: "Brother, brother, run away quickly, they are coming to beat you."
The executioner was wearing a flying fish suit, and a cold-faced eunuch stood beside him.
Zhang Anshi was so frightened that his legs were trembling.
He was a true man from two lifetimes, but seeing such a chilling scene for the first time, he was really inexperienced.
Subconsciously, Zhang Anshi wanted to run, but then he thought: Would it be too late to run now?
I'm afraid that if I run away, the consequences will be even worse.
After taking a deep breath and calming down, Zhang Anshi said obediently: "I won't run, I will accept the punishment, and I will kneel down as well."
As soon as he said that, he moved to make a place among the young man who was kneeling on the ground.
But the eunuch raised his head and glanced at Zhang Anshi: "Who are you?"
Zhang Anshi said: "Zhang Anshi."
The eunuch then took out a book, flipped it through, and said, "Zhang Anshi? Oh, your memorial is quite good. It shows that you have worked hard and you don't need to be punished."
Zhang Anshi felt relaxed all of a sudden.
At this moment, another whip was swung down hard.
Zhang Fu howled like a killing pig.
He was still saying vaguely: "Brother, didn't you say that you wrote nonsense?"
Zhang Anshi almost shed tears of sympathy.
The eunuch said again: "Since Mr. Zhang does not have to be punished and there are no classes in the school today, please come back."
Zhang Fu also chirped and said: "Brother, if you can't bear to stay here, you might as well leave. I can stand it."
"Oh." Zhang Anshi nodded and ran away quickly.
Zhang Fu: "..."
However, Zhang Fu had no time to think, and soon let out a scream like a slaughtering pig.
Zhang San was looking after the carriage and was looking outside. Soon he saw Zhang Anshi running out of the mansion like a rabbit.
Zhang San breathed a sigh of relief and stepped forward in surprise: "Young Master... what's going on? Master Hu's house was really ransacked?"
"The matter is more serious than imagined. I am afraid that some of my brothers may be involved."
"But Master, you..."
"I am successful in my studies, so I will not be punished."
Zhang San drooped his head, as if his brain was running at high speed, thinking about whether there were other ambiguities in these words.
Zhang Anshi said: "It's best to leave quickly and don't dwell on it. My brothers are like this. I feel very sad. I have to get them some medicine."
"Oh." Zhang San nodded blankly."The emperor, who is destined to be the emperor, said: Recently I heard that the relatives of the prince of the East Palace have been acting wildly. The relatives of the emperor and the country cannot be restrained, and they are so rampant. It is really unseemly. Every time I think about it, this must be the reason for the arrogance of the East Palace. , The prince cannot discipline his relatives, how can he govern the world? Today I am issuing an edict to you to teach you that this prince knows what is good and what is bad, and you must never tolerate it again. If there is a next time, you will not be lenient. Thank you!"
At this time, in the East Palace, a eunuch was singing a decree from the palace at the top of his voice.
The words in the decree are very vulgar. Of course, this has always been the style of Zhu Di's imperial decrees.
Prince Zhu Gaochi knelt on the ground in a polite manner. After listening to the imperial edict, he was frightened and his face was pale.
After the eunuch who read the edict finished reading it, he smiled cautiously: "Your Highness..."
Zhu Gaochi sighed: "I know, you can go and reply to the order."
The eunuch has gone.
Zhu Gaochi just sighed and returned to the inner garden of the East Palace.
At this time, Princess Zhang came to greet the prince.
Zhu Gaochi held her hand, feeling depressed.
Mrs. Zhang was worried and said: "Did An Shi get into trouble again?"
Zhu Gaochi nodded and sighed: "It's different this time. Now it's up to heaven to listen, and the father personally issued an order to scold... ah..."
When Mrs. Zhang heard this, she immediately realized the seriousness of the problem and hurriedly said: "Your Majesty has issued a decree. It is inevitable that in the eyes of all officials, this is a signal that Your Majesty hates His Highness. If someone with intentions uses this to add insult to injury and search for other faults of His Highness, I am afraid that the wall will fall and everyone will push it down..."
Under normal circumstances, the emperor would not scold the prince. After all, the prince is the prince and needs to establish a certain prestige, so he will be very tactful in his instructions. But this time he was so rude, I am afraid that his majesty will have some ideas.
Zhu Gaochi was silent for a moment and said: "I am not worried here, but An Shi... Those with ulterior motives may not dare to touch me, but they can use An Shi to make trouble, which is detrimental to An Shi."
Just like the unpredictable weather in Nanjing, Mrs. Zhang suddenly had tears in her eyes. The tears fell down like a chain of beads. She choked and said, "My brother lost his father in his early years. My sister married into a palace. The palace gates are so tight that I can't take care of him all the time. He is left alone outside. He is young and ignorant. He is afraid that many friends around him will trick him into doing evil..."
Zhu Gaochi was moved by this and quickly comforted him: "An Shi has good intentions. Don't cry. Everything can be discussed in the long run."
Zhang's tears immediately stopped and she looked at the young eunuch beside her and said, "Go and call my brother."
So the eunuch hurried away.
Zhang Anshi was really stimulated this time, especially after seeing Zhang Fu's butt being beaten to pieces, he felt even more sad.
He was summoned to the East Palace and entered the inner garden.
He hurried into the palace and saw his sister Zhang, so he smiled and said: "Sister."
Mrs. Zhang pretended to be unhappy: "What have you done again? I'm so pitiful. It doesn't matter that my mother's family has no support. As brothers, you can't share the worries, but you still cause trouble every day."
Zhu Gaochi said from the side: "Okay, okay..."
Mrs. Zhang said: "Look at his playful and smiling face... ugh..." After saying that, she stretched out her hand to wipe away her tears and began to sob.
Zhang Anshi couldn't see this, so he quickly stopped smiling, lowered his head and said, "What did I do wrong again?"
Zhang said: "Today, Your Majesty issued an imperial edict to reprimand your brother-in-law. He said that he was incompetent in discipline, and also said that he was conniving and covering up. He is the prince, a dignified prince. To be reprimanded like this, every civil and military man in the court would not laugh at it!"
"You silly brother, don't you know how difficult your brother-in-law is? Your Majesty doesn't like him, and there are countless treacherous villains around the Holy Driver who stir up trouble every day. Look at how worried your brother-in-law is."
Zhang Anshi went to see Zhu Gaochi.
But seeing Zhu Gaochi also looking sad, he cheered up and said, "IHe is a son of man, he cannot share your worries for you, and he deserves to be reprimanded... An Shi is still young, that's all... What's the point of saying this. "
